text: Read chemical-kinetics/20261117-2 collect-1. (1) Not landed: a tool's errors/ files are optional. The template's run_tool.py error_template uses a tool's own error contract for a category when it ships one and otherwise builds a generic one, and the rheo-fixture bundles declare invalid_input with no file. So a declared error without a file is not a fault B16 should name. What design-tool-interface asks, a fixture call per error a tool can return, is the place to look if unavailable is never exercised. (2) A relative --bundle with --source is read from the source (1959420). The run may be removed.
